text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober is desperate to get back in 
top form. Air Groove appears before her 
and sharply points out the fear harbored 
within Dober's heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Through her conversation with Air Groove, 
Mejiro Dober realizes she was terrified
of 
breaking her vow with Mejiro Bright and 
betraying everyone's expectations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, that fear only arose because 
Mejiro Dober was taking on a challenge
and 
carrying the expectations of those around 
her. In turn,
it was something that helped her grow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The trembling and fear haven't faded.
Even so, for the sake of everyone placing
their 
hopes in me, I want to see the Oaks 
through to the very end...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A powerful light burned in Mejiro Dober's 
eyes as she spoke, making the Trainer 
certain that she was going to be just 
fine—
